title: Sunstrike
summary: A fighter jet tearing through golden-hour clouds, pixel art with volumetric light.
description: A fighter jet rolls through a sea of golden-hour clouds in a seamless 20 second loop. Pixel art rendered from a low-resolution buffer with raymarched volumetric clouds, PBR metal with a sun glint and afterburner shock diamonds. One self-contained HTML file with three.js; everything is generated in code. Built by Qwen 4 Max Preview in DeepSeek Harness with high reasoning from the same prompt as the other entries in this comparison, then revised over several rounds of feedback with screenshots taken on a real GPU.
